name: Kayn
source: The eldest son of the Glasse family, a knight apprentice, and Cecil’s older brother. He wields the family heirloom “Guardian Sword” and is highly skilled with it. He dislikes formality and is friendly with everyone, also a feminist. He fell in love at first sight with Usada and became her huge fan. He dotes on Cecil and often follows her when she wanders off.
